text: SUPERVISOR: CAMRAY scope addition — USER bug, live session, verbatim: "camera actually has some raycasting problems with going up ramps where it zooms way the fuck in for no reaason". Walking up a ramp triggers the camera constraint hard — the camera zooms way in with nothing actually occluding the player. Likely the constraint ray is hitting the ramp surface (the new thin-slab ramps and/or their heightfield) and classifying walkable ground as an occluding wall. Print what the ray actually hits during a ramp ascent (surface id/kind, hit distance, the resulting clamp), read the data, fix the classification: walkable surfaces — especially the surface the player stands on — are not occluders; the constraint exists for WALLS between camera and player. This joins the CAMRAY done-bar: tape flat AND ramp ascent/descent with no false zoom, no see-through. Coordinate with the ramp lane only by READING its committed/in-tree collision shapes — do not edit ramp files; if the bug needs a ramp-side change, report it to me.
